description:
Find catalog tracks from a plain-language description of how they sound — e.g.
    "melancholic piano, slow", "dark ambient strings", "upbeat acoustic guitar, fast".

    Understands instruments and voice (piano, guitar, acoustic guitar, violin, cello, strings,
    harp, flute, sax, brass, organ, choir, a cappella, rap, 808/drum machine, orchestral),
    mood (sad/melancholic, dark/eerie, angry, ambient, happy/upbeat, chill/relaxed),
    character (acoustic, instrumental, with vocals, energetic, soft, danceable), tempo
    (slow <= 95 BPM, mid-tempo, fast >= 125 BPM, applied as filters) and any catalog genre.
    Sound words are scored from audio analysis of each track, not titles; every word has to
    hold. The response's `description.understood` shows how each word was read and
    `ignored_words` lists words that were NOT used — rephrase those. Each result has `match`
    (0-1) and a per-word `matched` breakdown. Costs 1 quota unit.

genre.description: Optional: only these catalog genres (comma list), in addition to any genre named in q. Unknown names in a list are skipped and listed in filters.ignored with close matches; only a list where every name is unknown is rejected.
genre.title: Genre

key.description: Optional: only these keys — Camelot ('8A'), Open Key ('1m') or names.
key.title: Key

min.description: Optional HARD lower bounds, e.g. {'tempo': 120}. Attributes: acousticness, danceability, duration_ms, energy, loudness, tempo, valence.
min.title: Min

offset.description: Skip this many tracks for the next page; offset + limit <= 500.
offset.title: Offset

q.description: Plain-language description, e.g. 'melancholic piano, slow' or 'chill acoustic guitar'.
q.title: Q

name: search_by_description
title: Search Tracks by Description
